'''Manuel "Manolo" Jiménez Soria''' (born 12 August 1976)<ref>[https://int.soccerway.com/players/manolo-jimenez/45200/ Soccerway profile]</ref> is an [[Andorra]]n [[Association football|footballer]] who currently plays for [[FC Santa Coloma|Santa Coloma]] and the [[Andorra national football team]].
